label: coastal-deposition-v2
method: Identical strict-restored day-zero stocks. Actual ThermalRuntime.sync, full terrain routing/glaciers/dynamic atmosphere. No seasonal seek or climate regeneration. Every water step instrumented; Gregorian-normalized calendar starts March20. GPCC and model use exactly the same valid land intersection. Land precipitation is the actual deposited land amount divided by land fraction; old baseline deposition was uniform column rain. Whole-area vapor ledger retains TOTAL column precipitation.
coastalMethod: Signed net vapor face transfer weighted by the change in land fraction within 5–27N,60–100E. West/east of 80E separate Arabian/Bay branches. Amount in Gt. Includes recipient coastal mountain/front rain; excludes rain intercepted on donor land. Measures coastal transfer, not historical marine provenance. Gross in/out refer to positive/negative NET face transfers, not counter-exchange parcel totals.
